G3201.definition:
μέμφομαι  
 [in LXX:  Sir.11:7 41:7 ,  2Ma.2:7  * ;] 
 to blame, find fault : absol.,  Rom.9:19;  with accusative, αὐτούς (WH, txt.; αὐτούς, Rec., WH, mg.; on rendering with αὐτούς see Westc., in l),  Heb.8:8. †
 (AS)
